hero.title: Simplifying Childhood TB Diagnosis
hero.subtitle: An innovative mobile application to support clinicians in treatment decision-making using TDA algorithms.
hero.app_screenshot_alt: Screenshot of the CDSS TB app showing the main dashboard

benefits.title: Why use the CDSS?
benefits.card1_text: Computer-assisted CXR reading and severity assessments for reliable diagnostic support.
benefits.card2_text: Instantly calculates TDA scores based on clinical symptoms and laboratory results.
benefits.card3_text: Seamless interconnection with DHIS2 for real-time data collection and monitoring.

how_it_works.title: How it Works
how_it_works.step1_desc: Enter clinical symptoms and patient data into the intuitive app interface.
how_it_works.step2_desc: TDA algorithms analyze clinical data and chest X-rays (if available).
how_it_works.step3_desc: Receive a clear recommendation for diagnosis and treatment.

about.title: About the Project
about.mission_text: To evaluate a comprehensive TDA-based approach supported by innovative digital tools to transform childhood TB screening and management.
about.obj1: Assess the effectiveness of the TDA approach compared to the standard of care.
about.obj2: Analyze feasibility and acceptability among healthcare providers.
about.obj3: Measure cost-effectiveness and budget impact for the health system.
about.obj4: Evaluate the value of lung ultrasonography and diagnostic support tools.
